fix.why_lv: Third conditional (A) izsaka nereālu pagātni. Second conditional (B) izsaka nereālu tagadni vai nākotni.

fix.q: A colleague says: 'If I had a better memory, I would have remembered your birthday.' What does the sentence say?
fix.correct: A quality now caused a result in the past.
wrong: Both parts are about the past.
Both parts are about the future.
It is a general fact that is always true.
fix.why: The if-part is past simple (a present quality: my memory is bad). The result is *would have* + past participle (past: I forgot your birthday).
fix.why_lv: *If* daļā ir Past Simple (tagadnes īpašība: man ir slikta atmiņa). Otrajā daļā ir *would have* + 3. forma (pagātne: es aizmirsu tavu dzimšanas dienu).

wrong: I don't know what to say to him.

wrong: Whomever
Whatever
Wherever

fix.why_lv: *Whoever* ir teikuma priekšmets darbības vārdam *booked*. Tas nozīmē *tas, kurš*.

fix.why_lv: *Whoever wins*: *whoever* ir teikuma priekšmets darbības vārdam *wins*, tāpēc *whomever* šeit nav pareizi.

fix.q: Choose the correct option: The concert was cancelled ___ the singer's illness.
wrong: owing
on account
as a result
fix.why: *owing to / due to / on account of* + noun: *cancelled owing to the singer's illness*. *Owing* and *on account* need *to* / *of*; *as a result* starts a new sentence.
fix.why_lv: *owing to / due to / on account of* + lietvārds: *cancelled owing to the singer's illness*. Aiz *owing* vajag *to*, aiz *on account* vajag *of*; *as a result* sāk jaunu teikumu.

why: Gate card_words: 'despite' and 'in spite of' are not on the conj_b2 card. Wrong options now from the card (although, however, whereas), all of which fail after 'and' + clause.

wrong: although
however
whereas
fix.why: *and yet* = but, in spite of this: *and yet they finished it on time*. *Although* and *whereas* start a part that needs another main clause; *however* goes after a full stop or a semicolon, with a comma.
fix.why_lv: *and yet* = bet, tomēr: *and yet they finished it on time*. *Although* un *whereas* sāk palīgteikumu, kam vajag vēl vienu virsteikumu; *however* lieto pēc punkta vai semikola, ar komatu.

why: Gate card_words: 'Despite' is not on the card; the sentence also copied the card example (Sales fell … therefore … close the shop). New sentence, bank from the card.

fix.q: The company lost its biggest client. ___, it had to cut twenty jobs.
fix.why: *Therefore* + comma at the start introduces a result. *Owing to* and *on account of* need a noun; *whereas* compares two facts in one sentence.
fix.why_lv: *Therefore* ar komatu teikuma sākumā ievada sekas. Aiz *owing to* un *on account of* vajag lietvārdu; *whereas* salīdzina divus faktus vienā teikumā.
